newsitem.title: USA: ESPNET SportZone may charge daily access fee - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: ESPNET SportZone may charge daily access fee - WSJ.

text.p: ESPNET SportsZone was seen becoming the first big Internet site to have users pay for access each day, rather than annually or monthly, the Wall Street Journal said in its electronic edition on Monday.
SportZone is a venture of Walt Disney Co's ESPN cable-sports network and Starwave Corp, the paper said.
It would join with CyberCash Inc to offer the service, the paper said.
